name: clutch flag
description: A sideways hold on a vertical pole where the lower elbow is wedged into the hip. It is an easier first taste of the human flag.
instructions: Stand beside a sturdy vertical pole and hug it with your near arm at chest height.
Grip lower down with your other hand and press that elbow into your hip.
Lean into the pole and lift your feet so your body hangs sideways.
Squeeze your legs together and hold your body as level as you can.
Hold, then lower your feet and switch sides.
